issues.where: the flying reptiles crossing in front of the breaking wave, all frames
issues.what: the animals are semi-transparent; rock, spray and sky show through their wings and bodies, so they read as ghosted layers composited over the plate, not solid animals with weight
issues.fix: render the animals fully opaque with proper occlusion and motion blur, lit by the same storm light

issues.where: the breaking wave and spray between the two sea stacks
issues.what: the wave does not land as one heavy wall; the white water is a see-through veil that fades in and out over the rocks and far arches behind it, moving like a cross-faded texture rather than water with mass that breaks and throws spray
issues.fix: simulate the wave as one opaque body that rises, curls and breaks forward, with spray that occludes what is behind it and falls back under gravity

issues.where: the whole frame over the 6 s hold
issues.what: with the camera held still the place hardly changes: the foreground pools, wet rocks, mist and stone arches stay frozen, the clouds shift only slightly, and the small animals on the right barely move; it reads as a still picture
issues.fix: add living motion at the hold: ripples and wash in the pools, drifting low mist at its own height, cloud moving across the arches, light changing, and animals that walk, pause and turn

issues.where: the foreground tide pool and wet rocks
issues.what: the water in front of the camera stays flat and still while a large wave breaks just behind; there is no surge, backwash or ripple reaching it
issues.fix: drive surge and ripples from the wave into the foreground water, with foam running across the rocks

issues.where: the flying animals' wing motion, frames 2401-2412
issues.what: the several animals flap with near-matched poses and spacing, close to an identical cycle; no individual timing
issues.fix: offset each animal's wingbeat phase, speed and path; let some glide, bank or turn

issues.what: set-B-02 frame 2400 matches set-B-01 frame 2401 image for image, so one sheet's numbering is off by one frame; could hide a duplicated or dropped frame
issues.fix: check the frame numbering and that no frame is repeated in the render
